fields.name: id
fields.notes: Production primary key. Present in the raw snapshot for traceability/joins only; NOT carried into the processed dataset (see governance/data-dictionary-v1.md).

fields.name: listing_number
fields.notes: Internal sequence number. Raw-only, same reasoning as id.

fields.name: property_type
fields.notes: apartment | villa | house for this cohort.

fields.name: listing_family
fields.notes: Constant 'RESIDENTIAL' by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: listing_purpose
fields.notes: Constant 'sale' by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: Constant 'LIVE' by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: is_valid
fields.notes: Constant true by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: is_duplicate
fields.notes: Constant false by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: archived_at
fields.notes: Constant NULL by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: price
fields.notes: Legacy price field; price_paise is the canonical advertised-price field used downstream.

fields.name: price_unit
fields.notes: Unit for `price`, e.g. INR.

fields.name: price_paise
fields.notes: Advertised/listing price in paise (1/100 INR). Null for 2 rows where price_status is inconsistent (see profiling report).

fields.name: price_status
fields.notes: 'NUMERIC' for the whole cohort, but 2 rows have price_status='NUMERIC' with price_paise NULL — a data-quality anomaly, not an 'on request' case.

fields.name: built_area
fields.notes: Populated for 1737/1737 rows; the field actually used for residential area, unlike area_sqft (always null in this cohort).

fields.name: built_area_unit
fields.notes: 'sqft' for 1736 rows, 'sqm' for 1 row.

fields.name: area_sqft
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort; kept in raw snapshot only to document the gap.

fields.name: super_built_area
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort.

fields.name: super_built_area_unit
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort.

fields.name: bedrooms
fields.notes: 0% missing in this cohort.

fields.name: bathrooms
fields.notes: ~33.7% missing in this cohort (586/1737).

fields.name: floor_number
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort (also NULL in listing_residential_unit_details, which has 0 matching rows).

fields.name: total_floors
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort.

fields.name: furnishing_status
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort (0/1737 populated).

fields.name: latitude
fields.notes: 0% missing. Potentially identifying at full precision — coarsened in the processed dataset.

fields.name: longitude
fields.notes: 0% missing. Same privacy treatment as latitude.

fields.name: area_key
fields.notes: Canonical area foreign key into public.areas.

fields.name: area_label
fields.notes: Free-text area label as stored on the listing; canonical_area_name (below) is preferred.

fields.name: canonical_area_name
fields.notes: Canonical Area identity, resolved via area_key. Preferred over area_label / free-text locality.

fields.name: canonical_city_name
fields.notes: Constant 'Bangalore' by construction of the cohort filter.

fields.name: seller_type
fields.notes: Constant 'dealer' for 100% of this cohort — a provenance artefact of this data load, not a natural distribution; see profiling report.

fields.name: trust_tier
fields.notes: Constant 'D' for 100% of this cohort — same caveat as seller_type.

fields.name: quality_score
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort (never computed).

fields.name: created_at
fields.notes: All 1737 rows share the exact same timestamp (2026-07-02T20:27:06.444759Z) — a bulk-load artefact, not an organic listing-creation time. Do not use as a listing-age feature.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.notes: Spans a few hours after created_at (bulk-load + resolution pass), not organic update activity.

fields.name: first_published_at
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort.

fields.name: last_live_at
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort (0/1737 populated).

fields.name: status_changed_at
fields.notes: Always NULL for this cohort (0/1737 populated).
